SELECT     'SALES BU'        driving_dim_code,    tl. business_unit_name   dimension_value,    TO_CHAR(tl.business_unit_id)  dimension_value_code FROM     dw_business_unit_d d,     dw_business_unit_d_tl tl WHERE d.business_unit_id = tl.business_unit_id   AND (d.primary_ledger_id <> -99999 AND d.primary_ledger_id IS NOT NULL)   AND language = 'VALUEOF(NQ_SESSION.USER_LANGUAGE_CODE)'

SELECT     'INVENTORY BU'            driving_dim_code,     a.business_unit_name   dimension_value, TO_CHAR(a.business_unit_id) dimension_value_code FROM       dw_business_unit_d b,       dw_business_unit_d_tl a WHERE language = 'VALUEOF(NQ_SESSION.USER_LANGUAGE_CODE)'    AND b.business_unit_id = a.business_unit_id    AND (b.primary_ledger_id <> -99999 AND b.primary_ledger_id IS NOT NULL)    AND  EXiSTS (         SELECT 1            FROM dw_inv_organization_d x          WHERE x.inv_business_unit_id = a.business_unit_id)

SELECT      'PROC BU'                               driving_dim_code,      tl.organization_name             dimension_value,     TO_CHAR(o.organization_id) dimension_value_code FROM      dw_internal_org_d o,      dw_internal_org_d_tl tl  WHERE      ( o.PROCUREMENT_BU_FLAG = 'Y' )      AND o.organization_id = tl.organization_id     AND (o.primary_ledger_id <> -99999 AND o.primary_ledger_id IS NOT NULL)      AND tl.language = 'VALUEOF(NQ_SESSION.USER_LANGUAGE_CODE)'

SELECT      'REQ BU'                                  driving_dim_code,      tl.organization_name              dimension_value,    TO_CHAR(o.organization_id)  dimension_value_code FROM      dw_internal_org_d o,      dw_internal_org_d_tl tl  WHERE      o.REQUISITION_BU_FLAG = 'Y'      AND o.organization_id = tl.organization_id     AND (o.primary_ledger_id <> -99999 AND o.primary_ledger_id IS NOT NULL)       AND tl.language = 'VALUEOF(NQ_SESSION.USER_LANGUAGE_CODE)'

SELECT     'PROJECT BU' driving_dim_code,     tl.organization_name   dimension_value,     TO_CHAR(o.organization_id) dimension_value_code FROM     dw_internal_org_d o,     dw_internal_org_d_tl tl WHERE      o.project_accounting_bu_flag = 'Y'     AND o.organization_id = tl.organization_id     AND (o.primary_ledger_id <> -99999 AND o.primary_ledger_id IS NOT NULL)      AND tl.language = 'VALUEOF(NQ_SESSION.USER_LANGUAGE_CODE)'
